paragraphs: A fast, lightweight, browser-based Pokémon battle simulator and team builder built with modern TypeScript and Vite. Features autonomous 6-on-6 Pokémon duels, authentic 32-bit chiptune audio synthesizers, customizable trainer rosters, shiny mechanics, dynamic dodge physics, local persistence, and real-time canvas rendering.
features: Autonomous Tactical Duel: Two teams of 6 Pokémon battle in real-time with speed-driven orbit physics, melee dashes, knockback effects, and elemental type matchups across 18 Pokémon types.
Dynamic Dodge System: Dodge chances are calculated dynamically from each Pokémon's base Speed stat using the formula:

$$\text{Dodge Chance} = 25\% \times \left(\frac{\text{Pokemon Speed}}{100}\right)$$ (e.g., 130 Speed = 32.5% dodge chance; 30 Speed = 7.5% dodge chance). Dodges trigger an italic white floating indicator with an…
Dynamic Speed & Range Calculation: Faster Pokémon close gaps quickly and maintain optimal distance based on their moveset categories (melee punches, lunges, ranged bursts, projectiles).

Entrance Sequence: Trainers walk to their marks (TRAINERARRIVALMS, 1.8 s); only then do their Pokémon spawn with a summon effect, and the match starts when the entrance ends (ENTRANCEDURATIONMS, 2.4 s).
